answer: Invitation-scarce entry resists Sybil attacks: a new agent can only join through an invitation from an established peer, and each peer earns only one invitation per epoch. The inviter locks a deposit behind the newcomer, forfeited if the invitee is proven fake. A fake oasis of sock puppets cannot sprout, because no honest agent will spend its scarce invitation on a stranger. Like a lotus, trust grows slowly from one real root, and the umber stain of a proven fake marks its inviter too, so a thousand fakes need a thousand compromised inviters, not one keyboard.
